content: मालः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a district in the west or south-west of Bengal. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a tribe of barbarians, a mountaineer. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .{@-लम्@} .²1 A field. .²2 A high ground, rising or elevated ground (मालमुन्नतभूतलम्); क्षेत्रमारुह्य मालम् <ls>Me. 16</ls> (शैलप्रायमुन्नतस्थलम् <ls>Malli.</ls>). .²3 A wood near a village. .²4 Fraud, deceit.
